query: I have a 46‑year‑old man to assess. Among male inpatients aged 41–51 with neutropenia and fever, stratified into tertiles by count of unique medications prescribed in first 48 hours, report LOS (days), in‑hospital mortality %, and 30‑day readmission %.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, a.admittime, a.dischtime, a.deathtime, a.los, COUNT(DISTINCT e.medication) AS num_medications, SUM(CASE WHEN a.deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deaths, SUM(CASE WHEN a.dischtime - a.admittime <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS readmissions FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id LEFT JOIN emar e ON a.subject_id = e.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = e.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 41 AND 51 AND a.admittime BETWEEN 0 AND 48 AND (a.deathtime IS NOT NULL OR (a.dischtime - a.admittime) <= 30) GROUP BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, a.admittime, a.dischtime, a.deathtime, a.los ORDER BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, a.admittime, a.dischtime, a.deathtime, a.los NULLS LAST;
